canonical_title: Anthropic IPO filing details government-relations and model restriction risks
aliases: Anthropic government attitudes customer ties IPO prospectus
Anthropic government contracts less than 1% revenue
treatment: Repeat only for a new government restriction, contract action, model availability change, material customer impact, or new filing disclosure that changes the practical risk assessment.
known_facts: Reuters reported from Anthropic's IPO prospectus that government attitudes toward Anthropic and its technology could affect commercial customers, partners and other business relationships beyond direct government contracts.
Anthropic disclosed that government agency contracts account for less than 1% of annual revenue.
The filing cites a February federal-agency stop-use order and a US Department of Defense supply-chain-risk designation as examples of government actions that could hurt the business.

Anthropic said June worldwide US Commerce Department export restrictions on Fable 5 and Mythos 5 caused it to disable those models for all customers until the restrictions were later lifted and the models redeployed.
reinclude_only_if: A government imposes or lifts a material restriction affecting Anthropic model availability.
Anthropic discloses material revenue, customer, partner or operational impact from government action.
A new filing or official statement materially changes the disclosed government-relations risk.
notes: Night-window hard delta: new IPO-prospectus details quantified government revenue exposure and documented prior model-wide restriction effects.
